biomarkers.name: ER, PR
biomarkers.clinical_use: Tamoxifen or other endocrine risk-reduction strategies (especially in classical LCIS)

biomarkers.name: Pleomorphic LCIS variant
biomarkers.clinical_use: Managed more like DCIS with excision to negative margins

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small, monotonous discohesive cells expanding lobular units (dyshesion from E-cadherin loss)
variants: pleomorphic LCIS (higher grade, managed as DCIS)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Classic LCIS considered a risk marker; pleomorphic and florid managed with excision

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Intact myoepithelium; expansion of lobular architecture

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Luminal epithelial cells of lobular acinar units with E-cadherin loss (same lineage as invasive lobular)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Luminal differentiation preserved with E-cadherin loss; distends acini without stromal invasion; myoepithelial layer intact
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Bilateral risk marker rather than obligate precursor — represents a non-obligate precursor/risk lesion with clonal relationship to some invasive lobular carcinomas; pleomorphic LCIS has more advanced dedifferentiation
